Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

This policy applies to YourTube: Watch & Discover, developed and published by American Group LLC, on iOS and Android.

Android packagecom.americangroup.yourtube

Accounts

You may create an account with Sign in with Google or Sign in with Apple. When you do, we receive the identifier the provider returns, your email address, and the display name you choose. Accounts are stored with Supabase (Supabase Inc.) under an encrypted connection. The app can be used without an account. You can delete your account and its data at any time — see Delete your account.

Device permissions

The app requests no camera, microphone, location, photo, contact or health permissions.

Android permissions declared: ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, AD_ID, INTERNET.

Advertising

The app shows ads served by Google Mobile Ads (AdMob). Google may use the device advertising identifier to serve and measure ads, as described in Google's privacy policy. Where required, the app asks for your consent before any ad is requested, and you can change that choice in the app's settings. We do not sell your personal information.

Purchases

The app has no in-app purchases.

Analytics and crash reporting

This release sends no analytics and no crash reports to us. If a future version enables crash reporting, this page will be updated first.

Network

The app connects to the internet to provide its features and to your account backend. Connections use HTTPS.

Data retention and deletion

Account data is kept until you delete your account, after which it is removed from our systems within 30 days. Anything stored only on your device is removed when you uninstall the app.

Children

The app is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

Your rights

You may ask us to access, correct or delete personal data we hold about you by emailing contact@safecodeg.com. We answer within 30 days.

Changes

We will post any change to this policy on this page with a new date.
